ctx.x: Moe Gale was the manager of the Savoy Ballroom. Also, he managed Chick Webb. He managed Teddy Hill. All the bands that played in the Savoy Moe Gale managed. In fact, when the Missourians was there, Moe Gale had Callaway signed up before he got to the Cotton Club.
